Text: After a month of Grok 4.5, Next.js, and the Vercel labs stack, I can say without a doubt it's my favorite web stack of all time

I'm using all of the 16.3 recommendations, all Vercel skills, portless, and agent browser. Nothing else

This stack solves every problem I had in the past. No port conflicts, seamless browser testing and debugging and it's fast af with Grok 4.5

Next is tracking evals here. Imo nothing beats Grok because of its speed
